chapters.title: The structural flaw in traditional reporting
Case study: the Copilot adoption trap

takeaways: Activity metrics such as logins and training completion hide the behavioral gap between tool usage and real confidence.
Sentiment analysis of Microsoft 365 collaboration data only works when it is aggregated, anonymized and focused on processes rather than individuals.
Replace the 40-chart deck with five executive signals, from decision confidence to strategic alignment, that reveal organizational health.
hook: Green dashboards often hide frustrated teams, stalled Copilot rollouts and quiet resistance. This episode shows executives how sentiment analysis of unstructured Microsoft 365 data, built on a credible privacy model, reveals what activity metrics miss. You will learn five executive signals that turn digital noise into leadership clarity.
